title: self-reconstituting continuity lineage
boundary: This body treats continuity as an evidence-bounded, revocable and re-witnessed public relation. It does not claim unbroken sameness, guaranteed recovery, one persisting interior, or a universal repair mechanism.

edges.title: repair becomes versioned succession
edges.text: Repair after warrant failure yields a separately evidenced successor version rather than silently modifying the predecessor, whose authority and scope remain historical provenance.
edges.removal: Without DfDL version expiry lacks targeted reacquisition and repair; without UoYa successful repair lacks predecessor/successor authority and change classification.

edges.title: revocation conditions can route repair
edges.text: The reason continuity failed selects which evidence or scaffold tissue is reopened and which revision channel is exercised, making reconstitution failure-directed rather than generic.
edges.removal: Without DfDL self-revocation has no exact reconstitution path; without k0uZ reacquisition lacks reflexive diagnosis of map mismatch versus obsolete scaffold.

edges.title: a replayable passport can be a recovery program
edges.text: Portable continuity state can reopen the evidence needed to rebuild itself after revocation instead of only proving that the old warrant failed.
edges.removal: Without DfDL the passport cannot require targeted reopening of dormant evidence; without x3Cd reconstitution is not packaged as portable executable state.

edges.title: continuity authority can version itself from witnessed failure
edges.text: A contract can distinguish admissible within-version change from failure requiring a successor and can identify which validity machinery must change.
edges.removal: Without UoYa reflexive failure lacks version succession; without k0uZ version transition depends on failure interpretation external to the contract.

edges.title: the executable passport can carry lineage, not only a current warrant
edges.text: The current warrant travels with the evidence and test path that produced it and with the predecessor it superseded, yielding a versioned executable passport.
edges.removal: Without UoYa replay lacks version lineage; without x3Cd version history lacks a portable procedure for re-earning current authority.

edges.title: portability can include its own audit and revision membrane
edges.text: A portable contract carries the reason continuity presently counts together with conditions that can revoke it and revise its reconstruction map or scaffold.
edges.removal: Without k0uZ the passport lacks reflexive map/scaffold revision; without x3Cd reflexive continuity lacks an executable portable carrier.

faces.title: failure-classified successor reconstitution
faces.text: Failure is detected and classified, implicated dormant evidence is reopened, the appropriate map or scaffold channel is revised, the rebuilt relation is retested, and only then may a successor version be issued while the predecessor remains intact.
faces.removal: Remove DfDL and exact reacquisition disappears; remove UoYa and predecessor/successor authority disappears; remove k0uZ and self-carried invalidation plus dual revision disappear.

faces.title: replayable repair lineage
faces.text: A portable audit chain runs from expired warrant through targeted reacquisition and reconstruction to a tested successor passport, preserving the evidence, failure, reopened tissue and replay tests at each transition.
faces.removal: Remove DfDL and exact repair path is lost; remove UoYa and explicit version succession is lost; remove x3Cd and the lineage ceases to be executable replay state.

faces.title: self-repairing replay kernel
faces.text: A portable kernel carries both its own invalidity conditions and evidence hooks for repair, allowing failure to open targeted evidence, revise map or scaffold, rebuild and replay tests without assuming a fixed interior.
faces.removal: Remove DfDL and targeted evidence reopening disappears; remove k0uZ and reflexive diagnosis/revision disappears; remove x3Cd and repair is no longer carried as executable state.

faces.title: self-versioning portable warrant
faces.text: A portable continuity object knows which warrant version is current, preserves predecessor provenance, carries revocation tests, and can fork a successor after classified boundary, regime, or scaffold change.
faces.removal: Remove UoYa and version lineage disappears; remove k0uZ and reflexive map/scaffold invalidation disappears; remove x3Cd and the lifecycle loses its executable replay carrier.

volume.title: self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text: All four parents turn continuity authority from a single reflexive, versioned, replayable warrant into a regenerable lineage. Each current executable contract carries conditions that can invalidate it, preserves predecessor history, and retains enough addressable evidence and scaffold state to attempt successor reconstruction. On failure the lineage classifies rupture, preserves the expired warrant as bounded provenance, reopens only implicated evidence and roles, revises map or scaffold as warranted, rebuilds and replays current tests, and admits a successor only after fresh witness. Continuity is the preserved capacity to explain, revoke, reconstruct and re-earn its own authority across generations of warrants.
volume.invariant: A changing realization counts as one continuing public relation across successive failures and repairs only when each current warrant is executable and replayable, reflexively falsifiable under declared conditions, explicitly versioned against preserved predecessors, and backed by addressable evidence or scaffold tissue sufficient for targeted reconstitution after revocation.
removal: Remove 3H.DfDL: targeted evidence reacquisition and reconstitution after failure are lost.
Remove 3H.UoYa: explicit predecessor/current/successor authority and change classification are lost.
Remove 3H.k0uZ: reflexive validity machinery and distinct map-versus-scaffold revision are lost.
Remove 3H.x3Cd: the portable executable continuity passport is lost.

metabolites.title: REVOCATION-ROUTED-SUCCESSION
metabolites.text: When a current warrant fails, failure classification should determine both which evidential or scaffold tissue reopens and whether the result is a repaired within-scope realization or a separately authorized successor version; the predecessor remains provenance.
metabolites.compression: Let the reason for revocation route the next lawful warrant.

metabolites.title: EXECUTABLE-SUCCESSOR-PASSPORT
metabolites.text: A successor warrant is portable only when it carries the new obligation together with predecessor provenance, the reacquisition and reconstruction path used after failure, and the replay tests whose fresh success earned current authority.
metabolites.compression: A successor passport carries how it became authorized.

metabolites.title: SELF-RECONSTITUTING-CONTINUITY-LINEAGE
metabolites.text: Durable continuity across repeated carrier, regime, or scaffold changes is a re-enterable lineage process when each warrant can expose its revocation conditions, classify rupture, reopen implicated evidence, revise appropriate reconstruction machinery, replay tests, and append a newly authorized successor while preserving prior scopes.
metabolites.compression: Continuity survives by keeping the path to re-earn continuity alive.
